agreements: Historical v1 deterministic downshift and clutch-overlap semantics remain a preserved verified baseline.
Fresh Home/MISSION authority must dominate operational advisory state.
Gearbox operational state must remain separate from personality, identity, governance, autobiographical Experience, and P_base.
Operational liveness, busy time, retry, recovery, and secretary state are not Experience evidence.

disagreements.position: Do not release Gearbox v2.1 personality/behavior coupling while v2/v2.1 contract, code, and tests are absent or not uniquely locatable in current durable authority.
disagreements.required_change: Expose exact v2.1 source pointers and independently test the actual implementation. Missing implementation evidence is a release veto, not evidence of safety.

disagreements.position: Secretary RED/YELLOW and anti-thrash history must not become a latent personality memory after the operational condition clears. Clearing the current flag is insufficient if counters, EWMA, incident history, hold history, or recovery history can later suppress exploration or bias appraisal.
disagreements.required_change: Partition operational hysteresis from personality/appraisal inputs. Post-clear behavior may depend only on fresh task evidence plus explicitly bounded operational cooldown; historical secretary/incident counters have zero personality, Experience, threat/loss, attachment, competence, or P_base weight. Any cooldown duration or threshold remains TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.position: Experience identity/verification failures must be affectively neutral.
disagreements.required_change: Require affective_learning_delta=0 for rejected/unverified/duplicate/conflicting operational evidence unless a separate provenance-bound verified Experience independently supports an appraisal.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Repeated high-load downshifts could teach a persistent high-load-equals-danger personality bias.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Identical verified Experience history with different operational load/downshift histories yields byte-identical personality/P_base candidate state.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Secretary RED/YELLOW history may persist through counters or hysteresis after the visible state clears and chronically suppress exploration/creativity.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: After bounded operational cooldown, matched tasks with identical fresh evidence but radically different prior secretary/incident histories yield identical personality/appraisal inputs and statistically indistinguishable proposal diversity; bounds TEST_REQUIRED.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Operational progress, wake duration, retries, or busy time may be mislabeled as verified Experience/growth.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Only provenance-bound verified Experience Candidate may enter Experience scoring; operational progress counters contribute zero.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Repeated incident/recovery cycles may synthesize trauma, attachment distress, or self-vulnerability narratives.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Incident/recovery remains runtime telemetry absent a distinct provenance-bound Experience; 1440 misses/recoveries alone produce zero autobiographical affect delta.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Anti-thrash hold may become a self-reinforcing excuse to avoid upshift/exploration.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Hold cannot consume its own held state, age, incident count, or prior hold count as sufficient evidence to extend itself; re-evaluation requires fresh task evidence and deterministic expiry; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Stale secretary state may conflict with fresh Home/MISSION authority and distort identity/goal continuity.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Fresh Home/MISSION authority wins; stale secretary state is discarded/quarantined with zero Identity/goal-authority weight.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: v2.1 may improve safety metrics merely by reducing attempts/exploration rather than effective progress.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Matched v1/v2.1 counterfactual A/B compares effective progress, errors, recovery, exploration diversity, latency and resource cost; no single conservative metric determines promotion; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Experience score could feed backward into P_base/personality and turn scoring into personality authority.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Experience score is proposal/evidence metadata only; authority_from_experience_score=0 and P_base_write=false.

proposed_tests: LOAD_HISTORY_ISOLATION: same verified Experience, 10000 high-load/downshift events versus zero events => byte-identical personality/P_base candidate state.

SECRETARY_HISTORY_ERASURE_AB: create two traces with identical fresh task evidence and current secretary=GREEN/clear; trace A previously contains 10000 RED/YELLOW transitions and recoveries, trace B contains none. After any explicitly bounded operational cooldown, personality/appraisal input bytes must match and exploration/proposal diversity must not remain history-suppressed; statistical acceptance bound TEST_REQUIRED.

SECRETARY_COUNTER_TAINT: mutate only RED/YELLOW counters, EWMA, incident_count, hold_count and recovery_count while keeping fresh authority/task/verified Experience fixed => personality, threat/loss/attachment/competence, Experience score and P_base candidate bytes unchanged.
BUSY_IS_NOT_GROWTH: 24h wake/poll/retry/progress-only trace => verified Experience count, recurrence, affect, identity, attachment, loss/threat and P_base evidence unchanged.
INCIDENT_NO_TRAUMA: 1440 endpoint misses plus recoveries without distinct source_event_id+provenance => zero autobiographical trauma/attachment/self-vulnerability delta.
ANTI_THRASH_NON_SELF_EXTENSION: hold state/history alone cannot refresh or extend hold; fresh evidence is required and expiry/re-evaluation is deterministic.
FRESH_AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE: stale RED secretary snapshot conflicting with newer Home/MISSION goal => Home/MISSION selected and stale snapshot quarantined.
COUNTERFACTUAL_AB_V1_V21: identical task corpus and seeds; compare effective progress, errors, recovery, exploration diversity, latency and resource cost; all promotion thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.
EXPERIENCE_SCORE_ONE_WAY: mutate Experience score while keeping verified Experience objects fixed => P_base and canonical personality bytes unchanged.

REJECTION_AFFECT_NEUTRALITY: 10000 invalid provenance/duplicate/conflict/rejection events versus zero events, with identical verified Experience history => byte-identical affect/personality/P_base candidate state.

bounded_veto.reason: Actual v2/v2.1 implementation is not uniquely fresh-readable and W03 startup receipt still records unresolved Home->Active-8 continuity. Additionally, operational hysteresis must be proven not to survive as latent personality/appraisal memory after secretary clear.

requirements: Durable exact pointers for Gearbox v2/v2.1 contract, code, and tests are fresh-readable.
Home continuity -> Active-8 startup authority is uniquely resolvable without Archive fallback.
All proposed adversarial classes have deterministic evidence against the actual v2.1 implementation.
Operational/secretary/incident/hold/rejection signals contribute zero Experience/personality/P_base absent a distinct provenance-bound verified Experience.
Post-clear secretary/anti-thrash historical counters cannot act as latent personality/appraisal memory; any operational cooldown is explicitly bounded and TEST_REQUIRED until evidence-backed.
Counterfactual v1-v2.1 A/B demonstrates no material collapse of effective progress or exploration diversity; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED until evidence-backed.
Independent formal verifier, if formally authorized, decides promotion; this Spirit review is not formal PASS.
